text:
kate: Heads-up from CS: several tenants hit quota spikes after the v1->v2 deprec banner. They say clients retried and lost headers. Anyone remember the sticky-header work?
alex: Saw that in logs too. The banner triggers a client-side flow that sometimes removes `x-api-version`. When missing, routing falls back to v1.
jon: We debated sticky headers in runtime last quarter. Quick mitigation: add a short "compat grace window" where runtime ignores missing header if it sees a recent request id, then prefer v2. Keeps UX but avoids quota blowups.
meera: Can console provide tenant-level opt-in for the grace window? Some customers asked to opt in earlier. Make it Routing -> Compatibility -> "Compat grace window (seconds)" with default 0.
kate: Nice. Default 0 avoids surprise behavior. For emergency we can flip org-wide 10s.
alex: Runtime sketch: if missing `x-api-version` and `X-Client-Request-Id` seen within last N seconds, and UA indicates a supported sdk, route to v2 and set `X-Compat-Source: grace-window`. Also emit metric `compat_grace_hit`.
jon: Pseudo: ```if missing_header and recent_request_same_id and ua_ok: route=v2; emit header X-Compat-Source:grace-window; tag=billing:compat_grace; sample=1%```
meera: Console UX: add toggle + numeric input for window; add tooltip: "If enabled, runtime will prefer v2 for probable retries for this tenant — reduces duplicate billing during deprecations." Also add link to rollback instructions.
kate: Billing ask: tag these with invoice_tag=compat_grace and zero-rate for a configurable period (eg 7 days) so customers aren't billed during our rollout. We'll reconcile later.
alex: We can inject `X-Redwood-Invoice-Tag: compat_grace`. Billing pipeline must honor that header. Gate all of this behind a feature flag `compat_grace_window` so we can ramp.
jon: Observability: new dashboard slice: compat_grace_hits, v1_fallbacks, per-tenant duplicate_request_rate. Add alert if compat_grace_hits > 1% of traffic or v2 p95 latency increases > 200ms.
meera: Who owns? Me: console change; Alex: runtime flag + header inject; Jon: dashboards + alerts; Kate: coordinate CS comms and emergency flips.
kate: Rollout plan: 1) Create console toggle (default off) 2) Ship runtime FF to 5 canary tenants 3) Monitor 2 hours 4) Expand if stable. Target window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT.
ops-bot: feature_flag created: compat_grace_window by alex at 1772223360
kate: Thanks — please keep messages short in the canary channel if you see anomalies. We'll need a one-paragraph note for customers if we flip org-wide.
